title: fix(ui): show later slash completions in command drafts
body:
Closes #164838

## What Problem This Solves

A caret-local slash completion disappears when the draft already begins with another command. For `/name Draft /statu after`, Enter can send the whole draft instead of selecting `/status`.

## User Impact

Enter or clicking the caret-local command sends only `/status` and leaves `/name Draft after` unsent. Tab only completes the token. Ordinary command arguments and active freeform-argument collection retain their existing behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

Apply the contributor's small precedence repair to the current Solid owner, `chat-composer-slash-menu-state.ts`: compute the caret completion before the leading-command argument branch, and let a visible inline completion own Enter before direct freeform inference. Active freeform collection still takes precedence, and existing canRun filtering/selection checks stay intact.

@ooiuuii's commits are preserved. Main retired the old Lit `.ts` owner; it and the469 old added test lines are not resurrected. No new helper, state, API, permission or command-catalog refresh behavior. #164863 is a distinct catalog-refresh repair, not this bug.

The existing ranking browser test retains its original unprefixed case and adds a leading-command prefix through parameterization. Whole-change delta against the merge base: production+5/-4, tests+3/-3(net0), docs+1. No test allocation or baseline increase.

## Evidence

[Independent built-UI Chromium receipts and five inspected screenshots](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164839#issuecomment-6556066820): secretless Linux Docker/Node24.22.1, actual built Control UI HTML/assets, real Chromium, mocked Gateway transport only. No component-only or Lit proof.

Twice on current main, the status option is missing and Enter sends `/name Draft /statu after`, clearing the draft. Twice on candidate, Enter and pointer selection each send exactly `/status`, retaining `/name Draft after`. Tab completes to `/name Draft /status after` with zero send calls. Ordinary finite arguments still complete to `/verbose on`; active freeform collection sends `/name title /statu` and leaves `Draft `, never dispatching the embedded `/statu` token separately.

Committed focused E2E: the original case passes on main; the new leading-prefix case fails at the missing menu. Both candidate cases pass (7 unrelated cases unselected). Targeted lint/format pass. Source SHA256 matches the built-container owner.

### Before / after

![Main has no caret-local completion](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/08dc692a-c38f-4693-b4c9-b77fb11bcdd9)

![Candidate shows the intended status completion](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4fcd2b05-f08d-429e-82ed-cf19ccf57bd1)

![Candidate sends only status and retains the surrounding draft](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e71c4c6a-9bfa-408d-aeb3-aa8c7ee7f28d)

## Merge Danger

Two-way door: reverting restores leading-command interference with later completions; no migration. Blast radius is Control UI slash-menu precedence and Enter/pointer selection. Existing connection/permission checks, command execution rules, active freeform ownership, ordinary arguments and Tab's completion-only behavior remain unchanged. No backend/provider or channel behavior changes.
